newsitem.title: USA: House approves extension of airline ticket tax.
newsitem.headline: House approves extension of airline ticket tax.

text.p: The House Wednesday approved a bill to reimpose the 10 percent airline ticket tax until Sept. 30. The vote was 347-73, sending the bill to the Senate.
The ticket tax expired Dec. 31. Revenues from the tax go to the airport and airways trust fund which is used to pay for improvements at airports and in the air traffic control system.
Administration officials said the trust fund might run out of money next month unless the tax was reimposed.
But some conservative House members opposed reinstating the tax unless there was an offsetting tax cut.
Several major airlines say the tax is unfair to them and have asked Congress to replace it with user fees.
